meta.title: Pricing
meta.description: Pemby is free to start. Passes of 1, 3 or 6 months add instant matches and unlimited application kits. One-time payment, no auto-renew, 14-day refunds.

hero.title: Free to start. A pass when you want matches the moment they appear.
hero.lede: Pemby is AI job-matching software. It finds jobs that can hire you from your country and sends them to you. You apply yourself.
hero.noteOneTime: One-time payment. No auto-renew. No subscription to cancel.

compare.title: What you get

brief.feature: Your Brief, with near misses and what blocked them

delivery.feature: Match delivery on Telegram, email and web push

kits.feature: Application kits: CV bullets, cover letter, screening answers

green.feature: Green matches: hires from your country

yellow.feature: Yellow matches: likely hires from your country

extension.feature: Chrome extension that fills forms in your browser, you click submit

compare.freeNote: Free matches arrive 24 hours late, and each late message says so.
compare.quietNote: Your quiet hours apply on Free and on a pass. Messages wait until quiet hours end.
compare.ownKeyNote: Need more kits without a pass? Connect your own OpenRouter account and pay OpenRouter directly for what you use.

passes.title: Passes
passes.lede: Pick how long you want instant matches. Every pass has the same features.
passes.currencyNote: Prices in US dollars. Tax may be added at checkout, depending on where you live.
passes.includes: Instant delivery, unlimited kits, yellow matches if you want them, and the no-match guarantee.

cta.notOpenDetail: Checkout is not open yet. Nobody is charged until it opens.

oneTime.title: One payment, fixed time
oneTime.body: A pass is a single payment for 30, 90 or 180 days of access. It never renews. We never charge you again unless you buy another pass.

stack.title: Renewals stack
stack.body: Buy a new pass before your current one ends and the new days are added to the end. You lose no time.

reminder.title: A reminder before it ends
reminder.body: We remind you 5 days before your pass ends. When it ends, your account returns to Free. Your profile, matches and kits stay.

diagram.next: Next pass, added to the end

refunds.title: 14-day refunds
refunds.body: Changed your mind? Email <email>hello@pemby.app</email> within 14 days of buying a pass and we refund the full price. No reason needed. A refund ends that pass.

guarantee.title: No-match guarantee
guarantee.body: If your active pass sends you zero matches for 14 days in a row, we add 14 days to it. You do not need to ask.
guarantee.scope: The guarantee covers pass time. It is not a promise about jobs, interviews or offers.

landed.title: Landed a role?
landed.body: Tell Pemby and pause your pass. The remaining days wait for you until you resume.

whatItIs.title: Software, not an agency
whatItIs.body: Pemby is AI job-matching software. It does not place candidates with employers, it does not apply for you, and employers do not pay us. You decide where to apply and you send every application yourself.

subscription.a: No. A pass is a one-time payment for a fixed number of days. It does not renew and there is nothing to cancel.

ends.q: What happens when my pass ends?
ends.a: Your account returns to Free. Matches arrive 24 hours late again and you get 3 kits a month. Nothing is deleted.

stack.q: Can I buy another pass before mine ends?
stack.a: Yes. The new days are added after your current pass, so you lose no time.

nothing.q: What if Pemby finds nothing for me?
nothing.a: Pemby tells you plainly and shows what blocked the closest jobs, such as no salary listed or a seniority gap. If this lasts 14 days during an active pass, we add 14 days to the pass.

outcome.q: Does Pemby get me a job?
outcome.a: No. Pemby finds jobs that can hire you from your country and helps you prepare your application. The employer decides, and you apply yourself.

kit.a: Draft CV bullets, a short cover letter and answers to screening questions for one job, based on your own CV. You read, edit and paste them.

tiers.q: What do green and yellow mean?
tiers.a: Green means the job post or the company shows it hires from your country. Yellow means it likely does, but the evidence is weaker. Every label shows its reason.

source.q: Where do the jobs come from?
source.a: From public job posts on company career pages and the applicant tracking systems companies use to publish them. Pemby re-checks each open job at least every 12 hours.

privacy.a: Pemby uses it only to match you and draft your kits. AI requests with your data require zero data retention. We never sell it or share it with employers. If you upload without an account and do not sign up, we delete it after 24 hours.

refund.q: How do I ask for a refund?
refund.a: Email <email>hello@pemby.app</email> within 14 days of buying the pass, from the email you used at checkout.
